label: Kpower
description: This extension for Karoo devices adds a device simulates a virtual power meter.
releaseNotes: Fork of KPower 1.9.6: road surface from the Karoo offline map, gravity from the altitude rate, gentler descents, wind factor, air density from the weather, optional snow adjustment, optional motion logging. Updates come from github.com/mostafa-k-m/Karoo-KPower. Coming from the original KPower you need to uninstall it first (different signing key).
